workforce.title: Welder
workforce.description: Structural, pipe and fabrication welding, with process-specific skills assessed for the role.
workforce.details: Discuss the welding processes and positions used in previous work, drawing interpretation, fit-up and safety practices. Confirm the employer’s practical test and any required certification; competence must be assessed for each candidate.

workforce.title: Electrician
workforce.description: Electrical installation, maintenance and testing for industrial, commercial or residential settings.
workforce.details: Relevant experience may include conduit, cable trays, panels, lighting, power circuits and testing. Confirm the permitted scope of work, local licensing requirements and the employer’s safety and assessment expectations.

workforce.title: Construction Worker
workforce.description: Site support across building, civil and infrastructure work.
workforce.details: Discuss experience in masonry support, shuttering, steel fixing, concreting and site preparation. The brief should specify physical tasks, supervision, protective equipment and site induction.

workforce.title: Site Engineer
workforce.description: Engineering coordination, supervision and quality review on construction projects.
workforce.details: Describe the discipline, project stage, drawings, reporting duties and contractor coordination needed. Review qualifications and relevant project evidence, with any local registration requirements checked separately.

workforce.title: Mechanical Engineer
workforce.description: Mechanical engineering roles in equipment, maintenance and production environments.
workforce.details: Discuss plant maintenance, equipment installation, process improvement and the technical tools used. Review the candidate’s qualification and project experience against the actual duties and destination requirements.

workforce.title: Machine Operator
workforce.description: Machine and production-line operations with attention to safety and quality.
workforce.details: Specify the actual machine, materials, setup duties and quality checks. Operating, programming and maintenance responsibilities should be distinguished, and practical ability assessed against the employer’s equipment.

workforce.title: Factory Worker
workforce.description: Assembly, sorting, packing and production-support roles.
workforce.details: Describe the workstation, handling tasks, production routine and quality expectations. Confirm shifts, training, protective equipment and any physical or environmental requirements before selection.

workforce.title: CNC Technician
workforce.description: Precision machining, machine setup and CNC operation.
workforce.details: Clarify whether the role involves setup, programming, operation or all three. Discuss relevant machine types, drawing interpretation, tooling and measurement, and agree the practical assessment and qualification requirements.

workforce.title: Caregiver
workforce.description: Daily support and companionship in care settings and households.
workforce.details: Discuss the care setting, mobility support, personal care duties, supervision and the candidate’s training. Confirm the permitted scope, language evidence and occupation-specific employment route; caregiving must not be presented as licensed nursing.

workforce.title: Nurse
workforce.description: Professional nursing roles requiring destination-specific registration.
workforce.details: Review nursing qualifications, registration status and relevant clinical experience. Recognition, licensing and accepted language evidence must be checked with the destination’s professional regulator and the applicable employment route.

workforce.title: Hospitality Staff
workforce.description: Guest service, housekeeping and food-service roles in hospitality.
workforce.details: Define the department and duties: reception, restaurant service, rooms or kitchen support. Discuss relevant service experience, hygiene, working language, shifts and any practical assessment.

workforce.title: IT Support Engineer
workforce.description: Helpdesk, desktop, infrastructure and network-support roles.
workforce.details: Describe the support level, systems, ticketing tools and escalation responsibilities. Discuss examples of troubleshooting and user support without requesting confidential employer data or access credentials.

workforce.title: Software Developer
workforce.description: Web, mobile and enterprise software-development roles.
workforce.details: Specify the stack, project responsibilities and expected experience. A coding exercise or project discussion can help assess relevant ability; agree the format and protect confidential work and intellectual property.

workforce.title: MEP Technician
workforce.description: Mechanical, electrical and plumbing maintenance for buildings and facilities.
workforce.details: Clarify the systems involved, such as HVAC, pumps, electrical panels or plumbing. Review practical experience, preventive maintenance and fault reporting, alongside any local licensing and safety requirements.

workforce.title: Security Guard
workforce.description: Access control, patrols and incident-reporting roles.
workforce.details: Specify the site, visitor procedures, monitoring duties and working language. Confirm training, background-check and destination licensing requirements before considering a candidate suitable.

workforce.title: Driver
workforce.description: Light- or heavy-vehicle driving for transport, delivery and logistics.
workforce.details: Specify vehicle class, load, route and working pattern. Review relevant driving experience and verify destination licence recognition, local testing and insurance before any appointment.

workforce.title: Warehouse Worker
workforce.description: Picking, packing, inventory and dispatch operations.
workforce.details: Discuss scanner use, stock checks, order accuracy and handling duties. Forklift work requires a separate check of relevant training and authorisation; availability or certification is not implied by this example profile.

workforce.title: Agriculture Worker
workforce.description: Farm, greenhouse and seasonal crop-support roles.
workforce.details: Describe planting, irrigation, harvesting, sorting or packing duties and relevant experience. Confirm season length, weather exposure, transport, housing and how working hours and pay are recorded.
